And thus saith the Lord: "Unto Le Noir be contentment, и unto the Brand Manager be tribulation и hammer."
With this sacred duty in mine hand, I call thee to answer: art thou an adherent of the rules, или... a fomenter of anarchy?

Lo, a new season is upon us again. один раз more shall we march forth in justice и valor. Lord, give me strength to gallop on through the trials in unfaltering adamance.
Let Le Noir be laid upon the pedestal of fashion, which the hundreds of millions of customers при the Grand Magasin may worship и adore.

As sunlight groweth intense, those abominable Néants press upon mine eyes... Though selfsame may their ultimate purpose be to the Rouges' endeavor... I would be loath to squander my vigilance on idlers who do naught but bask under the light in torpid indolence.

Thus cometh the season's end. Brutal were the toils, и in our march, the many lames of the armor bestowed upon thee have been weathered и spent.
The Alterationist must be quite occupied при the moment... But pray, bestill thy heart, dearest Rocinante, for когда today's labors end, we shall pay a visit to the fourth floor.

Our reputation hath taken a downward trend following our surrender of the Luxury Hall to the Rouges...
In seasons such as these, stratagem of premiumization и artificial scarcity have always proved to prevail.
... To preserve the value и worth of our brand, I hereby issue a general recall. First, let us commence на recalling products sold to Le Kaki.

Though we have lost our stronghold on the second floor, prithee, do not теряет heart! 'Tis not solely the Luxury Hall wherein the glory of Le Noir lies.
I am the Brand Manager—'tis my responsibility to embrace even the Noirs who are ignoble, и assist them to raise their prestige to a level befitting that of Le Noir's name. Do what thou canst to help.

Thy warm consolation I receive with gratitude... yet my heart hath already sworn fealty unto a Voice, и I shan't fain abandon my loyalty.
... Though unaware may the Obsidian God be... of my devotion.

'Tis no fancy of mine that the noble Voice showeth strange indifference to the sport of the "false god"...
Is the breaking of order, too, but compliant threads of destiny as written...? Or does He see fit to assay my worth? *sigh* I must comb these snarls from mine own thoughts.

I had thought I settled this matter beneath silence's cloak, outside even the Floor Managers' peering eyes... So how have the wretched Rouges intercepted the Golden Skein meant for the Alterationist's hands?
Если none of us Noirs have tattled this tale, then... Could it be—as preposterous a thought it is to entertain—that the false god hath stolen a glimpse of the prophecy?
... Silence hath befallen the shop. O Voice... whither have You gone? We of the Noir await Your coming.

The prophecy shall have its due—the dream of the Rouges will be consumed на stains of evil. I angle these nails mine upon thy dream of avarice и gluttony... и bring this hammer down with все my might.
A hammer один раз gripped must be brought down—that is simply the natural law.
Thou shalt make way in anticipation of my coming. Do this, и thy justice shan't fall to doubt.
Shh. Witness thou in silence, for the Obsidian God shall bestow upon us a blessing of His Voice anon.
I shall be the vanguard, so that thou mayest find safety behind me.
Witness thou in silence.
... Profane.
God's vengeance is swift и final.
I too... shall be... eternally preserved...
There can be no hesitation nor failure, for the Obsidian God watcheth over us.
Despair ye not in the face of misfortune; 'tis but a portent of imminent providence.

Though many have fallen to the ground, forsooth... Thou needst not concern thyself, за каждые moment of our suffering is etched в и remembered на Grand Magasin Sisyphe itself.
The fallen Noirs, too, are fabric и pillar... who shall with us together weave eternity.
... An orderly conclusion, drawn exactly as foretold на fate. Verily, the Obsidian God's wisdom is vast.

I... have followed the path of unerring order... и never veered off course...
Even когда... the price of that devotion... was to be my life...
